steps.title: Agent hook interface
steps.what: Each agent is covered through its own hook interface, written to the machine-level managed configuration that agent reads, so there is nothing for a developer to install.
steps.why: A coding agent reads the repository, takes instructions from files in it, calls internal tools and holds the developer's credentials, yet its traffic bypasses every gateway control, so prompts and source leave uninspected.

steps.what: Prompts, shell commands, file reads, MCP calls and tool results are evaluated by the same gateway, policies and detection as LLM and MCP traffic, with one place to author and one audit trail.
